sources.title: Noctua 为 AMD AM5 和 AM4 处理器带来航天级碳纳米管导热垫 / Noctua brings space-grade carbon nanotube thermal pad to AMD AM5 and AM4 processors

sources.summary: Noctua says the NT-CP1 uses carbon nanotubes originally developed for aerospace applications, with the material gradually adapting to microscopic surface imperfections to improve heat transfer over repeated heating and cooling cycles.
sources.summary_zh: Noctua 表示，NT-CP1 使用最初为航空航天应用开发的碳纳米管，该材料逐渐适应微观表面缺陷，以改善重复加热和冷却循环中的传热。
